what: Write your own songs on six tracks, or let the machine conjure one in twelve styles. Then cast THE SPELL and play it live from the keys. Summon beings that haunt your chords, brew sound through the ALEMBIC, and meet creatures along the way. An occult groovebox, built on Skiff by illuminus5.
author: tammygucci
